theater: 鄆城梁山泊、黃泥岡與潯州

battle.name: 宋江起義
battle.theater: 鄆城梁山泊、黃泥岡與潯州
battle.brief: 宣和元年六月，晁蓋、吳用等八人在黃泥岡以蒙汗藥迷倒押運生辰綱的殿司制使楊志，一夜之間劫走生辰綱而聚義梁山泊。押司宋江私放晁蓋、殺滅閻婆惜，刺配江州後題反詩被判斬，晁蓋等遂在潯陽縣法場劫囚相救。官軍以舟師、蒙衝與火箭攻水泊寨栅，至宣和三年始擒宋江，平此小而急的起義。

kit.name: 希臘火
kit.history: 配在銅管裡的燃燒劑。配方是帝國的機密，配方和船一起沉了。

countries: 本役的交戰方只有兩面：起義的梁山義軍與北宋的官軍，而兩面的組織都屬地方性、臨時性。義軍這一面，骨幹是史書所稱宋江等三十六人，實則是一群以私掠為業、靠碼頭與運河謀生的亡命之徒——押司出身的宋江、地方豪勢出身的晁蓋、落第書生吳用、道人公孫勝、漁家兄弟、賣唱的、裁縫、船家、獵戶、逃兵與逃犯，各帶自己的鄉里與舊識入夥；平日在梁山泊水寨中按山寨方式編排，首領之位隨成敗轉移，無固定軍籍，也無固定番号。起義爆發於劫取生辰綱之後，先以三十六人為核心，再由受招安、結夥、攻破州縣一路吸納新血，人數由數十擴到數百上千，散在梁山泊周邊的村鎮、礦場與水道之中，朝廷檔案稱之為群盜。官軍這一面，樞密院掌調兵，地方知州、縣尉、都頭掌捕拿，州縣弓箭手、鄉兵與禁軍是骨幹；宣和三年討平方臘的兵馬由童貫以宣撫使總領，張叔夜以亳州知州兼提舉兵馬巡檢的身分受命收拾京東這一支，兵員的編成、糧餉的調度與賞罰的權柄分屬數處，一紙文書往往要走數日才能落到執行的人手上。侯蒙以御史中丞的身分提出招撫之策，卻無兵無權，只能把方略留在紙面。兩面的差距不在器械，而在組織：義軍以熟人關係與山寨規矩維繫，官軍以文書與保甲維繫；起義一旦離開水泊、靠上運河與州城，義軍內部的紐帶就會被拉斷。
countriesEn: Only two sides fought in this campaign, the Liangshan insurgents and the government forces of the Northern Song, and the organisation of both was local and improvised. On the rebel side the backbone was the thirty-six men whom the official histories call Song Jiang and his companions, in fact a band of men living by plunder along the wharves and canals: Song Jiang, a yamen clerk; Chao Gai, a local notable; Wu Yong, a failed examination candidate; Gongsun Sheng, a Taoist priest; three brothers who fished; a singer, a tailor, boatmen, hunters, deserters and fugitives from justice, each bringing his own kinsmen and old acquaintances along. They were ranged in the manner of a mountain stronghold rather than an army while they stayed in the water forts of the marsh, the seat of leadership shifting with success and failure, with no fixed enlistment rolls and no fixed designations. The rising began with the seizure of the birthday gifts, was first built on those thirty-six men, and then drew in new blood through amnesty, through new companions and through the taking of prefectures and counties, growing from dozens to hundreds and thousands scattered among the villages, the workings and the waterways around the marsh; the court's own records called them a band of robbers. On the government side the Privy Council allocated troops while prefectures, county magistrates and constables handled the arrests, with county archers, local militia and imperial guards as the backbone. The troops raised against Fang La in Xuanhe 3 were commanded in overall terms by Tong Guan as pacification commissioner, while Zhang Shuye, magistrate of Bo prefecture and officer in charge of the local troops, was given the task of finishing off this band in the capital region; the raising of men, the movement of grain and the authority to reward and punish were split among several offices, so that a single document often took days to reach the men who had to carry it out. Hou Meng, censor-in-chief, proposed a policy of amnesty, but having neither soldiers nor authority he could only leave his strategy on paper. The gap between the two sides lay not in equipment but in organisation: the insurgents were held together by personal ties and the rules of a stronghold, the government by documents and by the mutual-surety system. The moment the insurgents left the marsh and leaned on the canals and on the walled cities, the bonds that held them together began to snap.
people: 宋江是本役的中心人物，字公明，鄆城縣押司，掌文書、批勘、勾攝公事，江湖上人稱及時雨。他以職權之便私放晁蓋，事後為遮掩而殺人滅口，殺的是與他同住的閻婆惜——那女子貪財，又與張文遠有私，並拿私放晁蓋的事要挾，屢次逼他寫休書。東窗事發後宋江夜遁，先投滁州柴進莊，再由揭陽入江州，刺配途中遇黑旋風李逵，抵江州又會神行太保戴宗。他在潯陽樓題下反詩，被黃文炳告發，判斬；戴宗以神行法回報梁山，晁蓋便定下劫法場之計。晁蓋是義軍第一位首領，綽號托塔天王，膽大而少算，智取生辰綱的主意出自吳用，他提供的是人望與膽量，後來攻打曾頭市中箭身亡，首位讓出，宋江接位後以呼保義之名統眾。吳用是全役的智囊，智取生辰綱、劫法場、破祝家莊都出他的手；公孫勝以道術參與攻守，在兩軍對陣時反過來迷惑官軍的判讀。戴宗、李逵、張順、李俊各在其位：李逵在刑場上用兩把板斧砍開宋江的枷，張順與李俊的水路是整場越獄的接應命脈。楊志是對面的代表，綽號青面獸，殿司制使，押運生辰綱卻被取去，殺牛二落草，後來也歸入梁山，他的一生說明同一批人可以在兩面之間移動。官軍方面的關鍵人物是張叔夜，他以少量精兵在梁山泊外經營數月，終於擒得宋江，得力於他對京東水泊地形與梁山人事的熟悉；童貫是更高一級的指揮者，負責討方臘的全局；侯蒙在朝中主張招撫，是最早看出宋江可用招安收編的人。另一條值得留意的線索是武松：景陽岡打虎、鬧西門慶、獅子樓、十字坡與孟州的一連串事，把一批不願落草的人拖進了亂局。
peopleEn: Song Jiang is the central figure of this campaign. He was given the courtesy name Gongming and served as a yamen clerk of Yuncheng county, with control of documents, of countersigning and of the routine paperwork of arrest, and the world of the rivers and roads called him the Timely Rain. He used the powers of his office to let Chao Gai go, and afterwards, to cover it, he killed a man to silence the only witness, the woman he lived with, Yan Poxi: she was greedy, was intimate with Zhang Wenyuan, and used what she knew about the letting of Chao Gai to force him repeatedly to write her a notice of separation. When the affair came to light Song Jiang fled by night, first to the estate of Chai Jin at Chuzhou and then by way of Jieyang into Jiangzhou; on the road of his judicial escort he met the Black Whirlwind Li Kui, and at Jiangzhou he met the Divine Strider Dai Zong. He wrote his rebellious verse on the Xunyang Tower, was reported by Huang Wenbing, and was sentenced to death; Dai Zong ran back to the stronghold with the divine stride, and Chao Gai set the plan for the seizure of the execution ground. Chao Gai was the first leader of the insurgents, known as the Heavenly Pagoda, bold and short of foresight: the scheme for taking the birthday gifts was Wu Yong's, and what Chao Gai supplied was standing and nerve; he was later wounded by an arrow while attacking Zengtou market and gave up his place, after which Song Jiang, known as the Great Hero Who Protects the World, took command. Wu Yong was the brain of the whole business; the taking of the gifts, the seizure at the execution ground and the breaking of Zhujia village were all his work. Gongsun Sheng took part with Taoist arts, and at the two opposing fronts he turned the government commanders' reading of the battlefield against them. Dai Zong, Li Kui, Zhang Shun and Li Jun each held their own place: Li Kui cut through Song Jiang's cangue at the execution ground with two axes, and the water route of Zhang Shun and Li Jun was the lifeline of the whole rescue. Yang Zhi is the representative of the other side, the Blue-faced Beast, an officer of the palace armoury who lost his convoy on the road and later killed Niu Er and turned bandit before joining the band himself; his life shows that the same sort of man could move from one side to the other. The key government figure was Zhang Shuye, who worked around the marsh for months with a small force of picked men and at last took Song Jiang, largely because he knew the waterways of the capital region and the people of the stronghold. Tong Guan stood one level higher as the commander in overall of the war against Fang La. Hou Meng argued in court for amnesty, and was the first to see that Song Jiang could be taken in by a grant of rank. Another thread worth following is Wu Song: killing the tiger on Jingyang Ridge, the brawl at Ximen Qing, the Lion Tower, Cross Slopes and the run of affairs at Mengzhou drew a set of men who had no wish to turn bandit into the disorder.
kits: 卡面這件希臘火，是七世紀拜占庭帝國的機密武器：燃燒劑裝在銅管之中，靠虹吸管把它射向水面上的敵船，配方不外傳，據說最終隨沉船一同失傳。它並沒有出現在北宋京東的戰場上；在一一一九年的梁山泊，既造不出這種銅管，也沒有引進它的管道。但把它放回技術譜系裡，仍能看清這場起義真正的器械邏輯：希臘火靠的是把攻擊延遲到敵人近前、靠載體把燃燒劑送到目標跟前、靠配方不外傳換取突然性；宋江這一方在黃泥岡做的恰恰是同一件事，只是載體從銅管換成一擔酒，攻擊從火改成蒙汗藥——八名漢子化裝行商腳夫，擔著酒在運河邊的黃泥岡接近押運隊伍，楊志一行人喝下加料的美酒後昏睡，生辰綱遂被從容搬走，隊中無人被殺。這是本役器械觀念所在：小型、隱蔽、靠欺騙與時機取勝，避開正面對抗。梁山泊真正用得上的，是水泊賴以為生的船隻——快船、搖櫓船、篷船，以及水寨周邊的竹木寨牆、拒馬與望樓；義軍步卒多持朴刀、長槍、弓箭，也有弩手配合，官軍則以弓手、弩手、長槍兵與披甲騎兵攻寨。最能說明宋廷技術水平的是攻水泊時用上的火器：把火藥附在箭鏃上射出的火箭，以及霹靂火砲、震天雷一類火藥投射物，已見於《武經總要》；再配合船首裝撞角的硬船蒙衝撞擊寨牆與水寨，舟師以船身結陣，步步進逼。這套裝備與希臘火同屬把火送到對方那邊的思路：拜占庭用銅管，十一世紀的宋廷用火藥與火船。真正被寫進史書的鎮壓手段則不在火，而在水陸圍堵與懸賞榜文。
kitsEn: The Greek fire on the card is a secret weapon of the seventh-century Byzantine empire: the burning liquid was carried in copper tubes and shot at enemy ships on the water through a siphon, the formula was never allowed out, and it is said to have been lost with the ship that carried it. It did not appear on any battlefield in the capital region of the Northern Song; in the marsh of Liangshan in 1119 there was no way to build such a copper tube and no channel through which to import one. Set back into the technological spectrum, however, it still shows what the real logic of equipment in this rising was. Greek fire worked by delaying the attack until the enemy was close, by carrying the burning liquid to the target in a vehicle, and by buying surprise with a formula kept secret. What the men of Song Jiang did at Huangni Ridge was exactly the same thing, except that the vehicle was a carrying pole of wine instead of a copper tube and the attack was a knockout drug instead of fire. Eight men dressed as porters of goods on sale, brought wine up at Huangni Ridge on the bank of the canal, and the men of the convoy, including Yang Zhi, drank the adulterated wine and fell into a stupor, so that the birthday gifts could be carried off unhurriedly and nobody in the convoy was killed. That is where the idea of equipment in this campaign lies: small, concealed, winning by deception and by the right moment, and avoiding an open contest. What Liangshan really had to work with was the shipping on which the marsh lived, fast boats, rowing boats and covered boats, together with the bamboo and timber walls of the water forts, the chevaux-de-frise and the watch towers around them. The rebels were mostly armed with side sabres, long spears and bows, with crossbowmen in support, while the government brought up archers, crossbowmen, spearmen and armoured horsemen against the forts. The clearest measure of the technological level of the Song court is the use of gunfire in the attack on the marsh: arrows with powder attached to the head, and gunpowder projectiles of the thunder-crash bomb and thunder-bolt type, are already described in the Wujing Zongyao; these were combined with hard ram-prow ships carrying an iron ram, used to batter the walls and water forts of the stronghold, while the fleet closed up in formation and pressed forward step by step. That equipment belongs to the same line of thought as Greek fire, both of them meant to put fire on the far side of the enemy's position: Byzantium used copper tubes, the eleventh-century Song court used gunpowder and fire ships. The means of suppression that actually entered the official records were not fire at all, but blockade by land and water, and posted reward notices.
tactics: 起義由三段動作疊成，每段的手段都與對手的方式相配。第一段是智取生辰綱：一面用分散的姓名、假扮的商旅身分與隨機應變的說辭靠近，一面用蒙汗藥把對手放到不能抵抗的狀態；動手之後不戕命、不追擊，立即分散退回水泊，隔一段時間再出來——這是弱方對強方唯一划算的打法，也是全役的原型。第二段是潯陽縣法場劫囚：晁蓋挑選精悍十餘人扮作劍客與死囚家屬，吳用事前安排動手時機與退路；午時三刻刑場之上，宋江枷號未動，李逵先以兩把板斧砍開刑具，晁蓋割繩，張順與李俊的水路在城外接應，眾人分兩路殺出城去，隨後又收拾了追兵，輾轉一個多月才回到梁山。第三段是水泊攻防：義軍把整座山泊當作堡壘，寨門設在渡口與窄水道，寨牆以竹木為主，四面皆水，來犯者必須仰賴舟師；官軍的辦法是以蒙衝撞擊水寨，用火箭與霹靂火砲焚燒寨牆與蘆葦遮蔽物，再以步騎由灘塗登岸強攻。這一場攻防的勝負不在火器，而在糧：只要宋江眾人不缺糧，官軍的每一次強攻都只換來短期壓制。真正終結起義的動作是政治性的——朝廷改用招撫，榜文懸於各州縣，許官許罪，斷其接應之路，又以熟悉水泊的鄉民為嚮導，官軍才得以在宣和三年攻破水寨。
tacticsEn: The rising was built out of three actions, each matched to the way its opponent fought. The first was the taking of the birthday gifts: on one side the approach was made with separate names, with the disguise of pedlars and with answers invented on the spot; on the other side the enemy was put into a condition in which he could not resist by means of a knockout drug. Nobody was killed and nobody was pursued; the men dispersed at once back to the marsh and came out again after a while. This was the only profitable way for the weaker side to deal with the stronger, and it is the prototype of the whole campaign. The second was the seizure of the prisoner at the execution ground of Xunyang county: Chao Gai picked a dozen or more of the hardiest men and dressed them as swordsmen and as the family of a condemned prisoner, and Wu Yong settled in advance both the moment of action and the line of retreat. At the hour of the third watch of the noon the cangue had not yet been taken off Song Jiang when Li Kui broke the apparatus of punishment with two axes, Chao Gai cut the ropes, and the water route of Zhang Shun and Li Jun waited outside the city. The men fought their way out in two columns, beat off the pursuit, and only after more than a month of wandering got back to Liangshan. The third was the defence of the marsh and the assault on it. The insurgents treated the whole sheet of water as a fortress: the gates of the stockade stood at the fords and at the narrow channels, the walls were of bamboo and timber, water lay on every side, and any attacker had to depend on boats. The government answered with iron-rammed ships against the water forts, with fire arrows and thunder-crash bombs to burn the walls and the reed cover, and with infantry and cavalry landing from the mud flats to force the positions. The outcome of that contest lay not in the fire weapons but in grain: so long as Song Jiang's men were not short of food, every assault by the government bought only a short spell of pressure. What actually ended the rising was political. The court changed to amnesty, posted notices in every prefecture and county, offered rank and pardon, cut the rebels off from all support, and used villagers who knew the marsh as guides; only then could the government army break into the stockades in Xuanhe 3.
data: 可用的數字要分清來源。史書一側：《宋史·張叔夜傳》記宣和三年（一一二一年）張叔夜討平方臘餘部，募得宋江等三十六人；《宋史·侯蒙傳》記侯蒙請以招撫收編京東群盜；《宣和遺事》亦記宋江等三十六人起事梁山泊。三十六這個數字在史書與說部之中對得上：榜文所列姓名、綽號共三十六人，包括宋江、晁蓋、吳用、公孫勝、林沖、秦明、呼延灼、花榮、柴進、戴宗、李逵、張順、李俊、史進、阮小七等；說部後來把這個數目擴為一百零八人，分作三十六天罡與七十二地煞，而那一百零八是文學的數目，不是史書的數目。說部一側：《水滸傳》寫智取生辰綱者八人——晁蓋、吳用、公孫勝、劉唐、白勝與阮小二、阮小五、阮小七；生辰綱十一擔，押運的軍士與腳夫數十人；劫法場出動十餘人；梁山聚義之後人數增至數百上千。地距上，梁山泊在今山東鄆城、梁山一帶，東距濟州百餘里，西距鄆城縣數十里，北距京師汴京四百餘里，黃泥岡、潯陽縣與潯陽江都在京東運河與濟水一線；自一一一九年智取生辰綱到一一二一年被擒，歷時約兩年。損失方面，史料只說三十六人被誅，沒有留下雙方死傷的可靠數目；說部寫法場之戰雙方皆有折損，卻是文學的鋪陳，不可當作戰史看待。
dataEn: The usable figures have to be sorted by their source. On the side of the official histories, the History of Song, biography of Zhang Shuye, records that in Xuanhe 3, that is 1121, Zhang Shuye took the remnants of Fang La and enrolled Song Jiang and thirty-five others; the biography of Hou Meng in the same work records his request that the band in the capital region be taken in by amnesty; the Xuande Yishi likewise records that Song Jiang and thirty-five others raised troops at Liangshan marsh. The number thirty-six agrees between history and the narrative tradition. The posted notice listed thirty-six names and nicknames, among them Song Jiang, Chao Gai, Wu Yong, Gongsun Sheng, Lin Chong, Qin Ming, Huyan Zhuo, Hua Rong, Chai Jin, Dai Zong, Li Kui, Zhang Shun, Li Jun, Shi Jin and Ruan Xiaoqi; the narrative tradition later enlarged the number to one hundred and eight, arranged as thirty-six heavenly stars and seventy-two earthly spirits, but that hundred and eight is a literary figure, not one found in the histories. On the side of the narrative, the Water Margin gives the number of men in the taking of the birthday gifts as eight, Chao Gai, Wu Yong, Gongsun Sheng, Liu Tang, Bai Sheng and the three Ruan brothers; the gifts themselves are eleven loads, with several tens of soldiers and porters in the convoy; the seizure at the execution ground involved a dozen or more men; and after the gathering at Liangshan the numbers ran to several hundreds and thousands. As to distances, Liangshan marsh lies in the neighbourhood of Yuncheng and Liangshan in present-day Shandong, a little over a hundred li east of Jizhou, a few tens of li west of Yuncheng county and about four hundred li north of the capital at Bianjing, while Huangni Ridge, Xunyang county and the Xunyang river all lie along the canal and the Ji water in the capital region; from the taking of the gifts in 1119 to the capture of Song Jiang in 1121 about two years passed. As to losses, the histories record only that the thirty-six were executed and leave no reliable count of casualties on either side; the narrative describes the fight at the execution ground as costly for both parties, but that is literary colouring and cannot be treated as battle history.
cause: 一場起義的起因通常有三層，宋江起義的三層都看得到。最外一層是北宋末年的搜刮：宣和年間，蔡京等大官年年有生辰，沿運河由各地起運的生辰綱一路護送入京，地方為承辦這類差事而加派、變相攤斂；同時蘇杭應奉局的花石綱攪動東南，州縣的吏治與差役之壞同時惡化，民間自保與私掠的風氣因此大盛。這是宋江這批人得以在運河線上聚眾的客觀土壤。中間一層是宋江個案逐步推成的連鎖反應：他以押司身分私放晁蓋，是第一次越界；為滅口而殺閻婆惜，使他從有功名的吏員變成待捕的亡命之徒；逃亡與刺配江州本是懲罰，卻讓他與李逵、戴宗、張順、李俊這些亡命之徒結成了生死之交；在潯陽樓題反詩本是一次酒後的失控，卻讓他被判死刑，因為朝廷對不穩的人只有一種辦法。最內一層是義軍自身的生存邏輯：三十六人之中多數本無兵無地，唯一的活路是控制水泊這片水網，靠劫掠、招納亡命、與官府對抗來維持；梁山一旦被圍、糧道一斷，要麼受招撫而解散，要麼死守到底。所有起義都會走到這一步：從個別的抗爭變成集團的生存，再從集團的生存變成與國家談判的籌碼。
causeEn: The causes of a rising usually come in three layers, and all three can be seen here. The outermost is the extraction of wealth in the late Northern Song. In the Xuanhe years the great ministers had birthdays every year, and consignments of birthday gifts were escorted from every part of the empire along the canals to the capital, while the local authorities added levies and twisted requisitions to meet the cost of such errands. At the same time the stones-and-flowers tribute of the Suzhou and Hangzhou bureaux disturbed the south-east, the administration of the prefectures and counties went bad together with the quality of their runners, and among the people a habit of self-protection and of private plunder grew strong. That was the objective soil on which men like Song Jiang were able to gather on the line of the canals. The middle layer is the chain reaction built up step by step from Song Jiang's own case. Using his office to let Chao Gai go was his first crossing of the line; killing Yan Poxi to silence her turned him from a clerk with a good name into an outlaw wanted by the law; flight and the judicial escort to Jiangzhou were meant as punishment, yet they bound him in sworn brotherhood with Li Kui, Dai Zong, Zhang Shun and Li Jun, men who were themselves in flight; and the verse written on the Xunyang Tower after too much wine was in truth a lapse of self-control, yet it cost him his head, because the court had only one way of dealing with the uncertain. The innermost layer is the logic of survival in the band itself. Most of the thirty-six had neither soldiers nor land, and their only way to live was to hold the network of water that was the marsh, sustaining themselves by plunder, by taking in men in flight and by defying the authorities. Once Liangshan was surrounded and the supply cut, there were only two possibilities left: to be dissolved by an amnesty, or to hold out to the end. Every rising comes to this point, passing from individual resistance to the survival of a group, and from the survival of a group to a bargaining counter with the state.
impact: 就當時而言，這場起義的直接影響有限，但它留下的東西比它的規模更耐久。第一是榜文：宋江等三十六人的姓名、綽號被寫成榜文，張貼於各州縣，懸賞捉拿，同時公告凡捕獲者賞、容隱者重罰、投降者許以不死。這套辦法把義軍從治安事件變成人人有責的案件，也把招安——以官位與赦罪換取解散——正式納入朝廷對付盜賊的政策工具；此後南渡前後多次以招撫收編群盜為兵的處置，源頭正在此類辦法。宋江起義與方臘起義幾乎同時，前者在京東、後者在兩浙與淮南，起義與鎮壓同時消耗朝廷的財政與兵力，暴露了北宋末年地方軍與中央禁軍之間的虛實差別，這才是它真正的戰略意義。第二是長久的文化效應：三十六人的榜文名單經說部加工，成為《水滸傳》一百零八人的骨架；這部小說在中國、東亞與歐洲的傳播，把聚義梁山、替天行道與逼上梁山變成漢語世界裡一套成熟的政治想像，日後的民間文學、戲曲、評書與近代的革命敘事都反覆回到這批名字上。第三是對後世用兵觀念的提醒：一群靠熟人關係與山寨規矩維繫的人，終究敵不過有文書、賞格與編制的國家機器；義軍在梁山泊可以與官軍相持，一旦被招撫並編入官軍，就立刻成為另一支可以遠征的部隊，這正是南宋對金作戰大量依賴招降與編制的先例。
impactEn: For its own time the direct effect of this rising was limited, but what it left behind has proved far more durable than its scale. First, the notice. The names and nicknames of Song Jiang and the thirty-five were written up, posted in every prefecture and county, and offered as rewards for capture, with the proclamation that those who seized them would be rewarded, those who sheltered them punished heavily, and those who surrendered them pardoned and given rank. That procedure turned a band of robbers into a case in which every man was implicated, and it brought amnesty, the exchange of rank and pardon for a surrender and dispersal, formally into the set of instruments by which the court handled bandits; the repeated resort to enrolling such bands as soldiers around the time of the move south had its origin in methods of this kind. The rising of Song Jiang and the rising of Fang La came almost at the same time, the former in the capital region and the latter in the two Zhe and in Huai-nan, and the rising and its suppression together drained the court's finances and troops while exposing the difference between the reality of the local armies and that of the central guards in the late Song. That, rather than the fighting, is the real strategic meaning of the episode. Second, the long cultural effect. The list of thirty-six names, worked over by the narrative tradition, became the skeleton of the one hundred and eight in the Water Margin; the circulation of that novel in China, in East Asia and in Europe turned the gathering at Liangshan, the heaven's mandate in place of the ruler and the driving of men to outlawry into a settled political imagination in the Chinese-speaking world, and the folk literature, the theatre, the storytelling and the revolutionary narratives of later times all came back again to these names. Third, a warning for later thinking about war. A band held together by personal ties and by the rules of a stronghold cannot in the end stand against a state machine that has documents, rewards and establishments behind it. The insurgents could hold their own against the government for a time inside the marsh; once they were taken in by amnesty and enrolled in the government army, they became at once another body of troops capable of being sent on campaign, which is the precedent on which the Southern Song relied so heavily in recruiting surrendered men and reorganising them for the war against the Jin.
result: 一一二一年（宣和三年），方臘敗亡，張叔夜以收拾餘部之名追剿京東梁山：先斷水泊外圍的糧道與村鎮支援，再集兵攻破水寨，終於擒得宋江及同黨三十六人，具名上聞並誅之，張叔夜因此論功，遷擢要職。梁山泊的聚義至此在史料層面告一段落：沒有攻入州城，沒有奪取郡縣，沒有跨區域的後續戰役，三十六人的榜文成了這場起義在官方檔案裡的全部痕跡。史實的結局是鎮壓，說部的結局卻相反：《水滸傳》寫宋江受招安後率眾南征方臘、再征遼、征田虎王慶，最後諸人封官而宋江被毒酒賜死——這個結局並非史實，卻比史實傳得更久，也正是它塑造了這場起義在後世的形象：起義者終究要回到朝廷的框架之內，功成之後的代價由個人承擔。兩相比較之下可以看得很清楚：北宋的鎮壓成功，靠的不是更強的武器，而是懸賞、榜文、招撫與對水泊地形的熟悉；自一一一九年智取生辰綱到一一二一年擒獲宋江，這條三年間反覆起落的路線，後來成了中國歷史裡最常被引用的起義如何結束的樣本：不是被殲滅在戰場上，而是被收編、被編制，然後在別人的戰爭裡被消耗。
resultEn: In 1121, the third year of Xuanhe, Fang La was destroyed and Zhang Shuye turned to the suppression of Liangshan in the capital region under the pretext of mopping up the remnants: he first cut the supplies reaching the marsh from the surrounding villages, then concentrated his troops and broke into the stockades, and at last took Song Jiang and the thirty-five who were with him, reported them by name, and had them executed; Zhang Shuye was credited with the achievement and promoted to a post of rank. The gathering at Liangshan thus came to an end on the level of the record: no prefectural city was entered, no commandery was seized, there was no war carried across regions, and the notice naming thirty-six men became the whole trace of the rising in the official archives. The historical ending is suppression, while the ending in the narrative tradition is the opposite: the Water Margin has Song Jiang accept the amnesty and lead the men south against Fang La, then against the Liao and against Tianhu and Wang Qing, and at last the heroes are ennobled while Song Jiang is given poisoned wine. That ending is not history, yet it has travelled much further than the history has, and it is precisely that ending which shaped the later image of the rising: the rebel must in the end come back inside the framework of the court, and the price of success is paid by the individual. Set side by side, the two make the point clearly. The success of the Song suppression rested not on better weapons but on rewards, on notices, on amnesty and on a working knowledge of the marsh; and the road from the taking of the birthday gifts in 1119 to the capture of Song Jiang in 1121, rising and falling over those three years, has become the most frequently cited model in Chinese history of how a rising ends: not annihilated on the battlefield, but taken in, enrolled, and then spent in other people's wars.
